tools.name: Create Soulwell
limitations: Party members must collect a Healthstone from the Soulwell
Healthstone is a personal consumable after collection
Healthstone has its own use cooldown

tools.name: Soulstone
limitations: Uses the shared combat-resurrection resource in combat
Can be applied before combat for self-resurrection planning
Long cast outside Soulburn interactions

tools.name: Demonic Gateway
limitations: Requires placement and party interaction
Connects two fixed endpoints rather than granting free movement
Route skips are dungeon- and placement-specific

tools.name: Shadowfury
limitations: Stuns only susceptible enemies
Stopped enemies can recast after the stun
Does not provide a spell-school lockout

tools.name: Curse of Tongues

requirements.value: Foul Mouth changes the single-target curse into a ten-yard application around the target

limitations: Slows spell casting rather than interrupting
Only one Curse or Blight can be active per target

tools.name: Blight of Tongues
limitations: Two-minute cooldown
Twelve-second duration
Only one Curse or Blight can be active per target

tools.name: Blight of Weakness
limitations: Primarily reduces attack frequency and critical-strike chance
Only one Curse or Blight can be active per target

tools.name: Singe Magic

requirements.value: Requires an active Imp or another configuration that grants Singe Magic

limitations: Removes one harmful Magic effect
Pet choice can trade away another demon's utility

tools.name: Devour Magic

requirements.value: Requires an active Felhunter, Fel Ravager window, or another configuration that grants Devour Magic

limitations: Removes one beneficial Magic effect from an enemy
Availability depends on active demon or talent window

tools.name: Spell Lock

requirements.value: Requires an active Felhunter or another configuration that grants Spell Lock

limitations: Pet-dependent interrupt
Only interrupts interruptible casts
Choosing another demon can remove access

tools.name: Soulburn: Demonic Circle

requirements.value: Requires Soulburn and a pre-positioned Demonic Circle

limitations: Self-only
Requires advance placement and a Soul Shard
Movement-immunity behavior is timing-sensitive

provenance.description: Patch 12.1.0 Destruction Warlock Mythic+ guide identifies current reusable utility, dungeon interactions, and affix usage.
Current spell records establish Healthstone, Soulstone, Gateway, curse, pet-dispel, and control semantics.
Current Foul Mouth and Blight records establish configured area application and one-Curse-or-Blight limits.
